description: The largest artery. It carries blood from the left ventricle to the rest of the body.
The section of the aorta that rises from just above the aortic valve.
The beginning of the aorta, where the aortic valve sits.
The ring of tissue that the aortic valve is attached to. It is the reference position where the new valve is anchored.

Calcium buildup that has hardened part of a leaflet. It is the main cause of aortic valve stenosis.
The heart chamber that pumps blood into the aorta.
